title: Brewser operational stats
description: Contract for play.brewser.io/stats.json (C2). Deliberately SEPARATE from catalogue.json: the catalogue is a pure function of git state; downloads/ratings change continuously and would destroy its diffability. Published by WP-Cron daily from the telemetry aggregates (swtel_downloads_map / swtel_ratings_list — the same source the plugin's Popular and Top Rated sorts read). Keyed by app id — consumers join by id; stats ids with no catalogue entry are ignored and reported (an app may have been delisted between publications). A missing, stale, or unparseable stats.json is NOT a sync failure: stats-driven sorts report themselves unavailable with a reason. NOT part of the golden test and not covered by the catalogue version field. Base-repo CI must NOT rebuild the catalogue on stats.json commits (trigger on apps/** and curation.json only).

ratingAvg.description: Display only — never a ranking input.

ratingCount.description: Display only — never a ranking input.

ratingScore.description: The platform-computed Top Rated score (catalogue-v2.md; empirical-mean Bayesian prior, computed by WordPress). OMITTED when ratingCount is 0 — absent means 'no data' and sorts last; it must never be published as 0 or as the corpus mean. The runtime sorts on this and never derives it.
